description: SCREEN every SEC filer by a ratio of two reported values: finds the companies whose numerator / denominator, for one period, falls in a range or near a target. Built for "which company had cash to total assets of 3.49 percent", "filers with debt over 80 percent of assets", "net income to revenue between 20 and 30 percent". numerator and denominator are US-GAAP tags (e.g. "CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue" over "Assets"), period is a calendar frame ("CY2023Q4I" for balance-sheet items at year end, "CY2023" for a full year). Give min_pct and/or max_pct, or target_pct with tolerance_pct (default 0.01). Joins two SEC XBRL frames by company (two SEC calls per question, no bulk pull) and returns matching filers with both values and the ratio in percent. Values are as filed; a filer reporting only one of the two tags is skipped and counted.

denominator.description: US-GAAP tag for the bottom, e.g. "Assets", "Revenues".

limit.description: Max filers returned (1-100, default 25), those closest to the target (or the range middle) first.

max_pct.description: Highest ratio to include, in percent (e.g. 4).

min_pct.description: Lowest ratio to include, in percent (e.g. 3.4).

numerator.description: US-GAAP tag for the top of the ratio, e.g. "CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue", "NetIncomeLoss", "Liabilities".

period.description: Calendar frame: "CY2023Q4I" (instant), "CY2023" (year), "CY2023Q1" (quarter). Both tags are read for this same frame.

target_pct.description: Ratio to match, in percent; with tolerance_pct sets min and max. Use instead of min/max.

tolerance_pct.description: With target_pct: allowed distance in percentage points (default 0.01).
